notablePrerequisites: Young Wolf does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Young Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Young Wolf's undying ability and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Young Wolf undying trigger, returning Young Wolf from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Young Wolf, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
